title: Semantic-Augmented Latent Topic Modeling with LLM-in-the-Loop
subcategory: LLM-guided initialisation and post-correction of LDA
task: Testing LLM help at LDA initialisation and topic post-correction
problem: LDA has semantically uninformed initialisation and topics with unrelated words; replacing LDA with LLMs has its own problems.
architecture: Few-shot Qwen2-7B-Instruct clusters documents to initialise Gibbs sampling (compared with random and K-Means initialisation); in post-correction the LLM removes semantically unrelated words from topic word lists.
key_results: LLM initialisation gives the lowest perplexity at pass 0 (7853.6795 vs 8158.6628 random, eta None) but is worse after 20 passes (328.9051 vs 309.3647).
LLM post-correction improves topic coherence by 5.86%.
strengths: Reports a negative result: LLM-based initialisation does not help LDA convergence.
Simple post-correction step usable with any topic list.

limitations.text: Single Chinese dataset, one LLM, two metrics; short paper.
Reported coherence values (from -17.8463 to -3.2723) lie outside the [-1, 1] range of NPMI, so the metric actually used is unclear.
